reason: The no-account, on-device setup and weight being off by default are what I want, but I'd read the privacy policy and use the free first summary before paying anything. My next appointment is weeks away, so nothing makes me pay this month.
objection: 'Runs entirely on your phone' is easy to say. The last period app said nice things too. I'd want to know who's behind it, what the AI write-up sends and where it goes, and whether the free tier gets cut back once they have users. I also need it to deal with trying to conceive. It can't just be a symptom log.
would_change_my_mind: An independent privacy audit or open-source proof that nothing leaves the phone, and a free summary that actually helps my doctor change something about my metformin or inositol plan.
